    • asNBT

      @NotNull @NotNull Optional<org.cyrus.nbt.data.CompoundTag> asNBT()
      Some data needs to be sent with the registry packet. This is done via NBT data. To see that extra data, use this. If the registry does not need extra data then Optional.empty() will be used
      Returns:
      The NBT data to send over the registry packet
